title: Case Intel · Tonight's cause list, already read
description: Case management for advocates practising before Indian courts: state-wide advocate search, order summaries that become tasks, cause lists from the Telangana High Court, most other High Courts and the District Courts read every evening and morning, and a case-file assistant that cites its sources. Sign up with Google.

sections.heading: Tonight's cause list. Already read.
sections.text: FOR ADVOCATES PRACTISING BEFORE INDIAN COURTS Tonight's cause list. Already read. Case Intel reads the cause lists of the Telangana High Court, most other High Courts and the District Courts at 19:00 and again at 06:30, finds your matters on them, and carries each one forward: the order that followed, what your side must do, the fee it earned. Create an account Log in Sign up with Google. Where a court's list can't be read, the matter says “Not covered” instead of guessing. sections.heading: The order arrives as a scan. You get what you must do.
sections.text: 02 · READ THE ORDER The order arrives as a scan. You get what you must do. Each order PDF is summarised once, when it arrives: what the court did, then your side's directions, kept apart from the other side's. Your directions become tasks with due dates. Due dates come from a fixed table of phrases like “within four weeks”, not from the AI. Unreadable, very short or routine adjournment orders skip the AI entirely. Only your side's directions become tasks, and only once your party role is known. IN THE HIGH COURT FOR THE STATE OF TELANGANA AT HYDERABAD (Special Original Jurisdiction) WEDNESDAY,

sections.heading: A misread column looks exactly like “not listed.”
sections.text: 06:30 03 · 06:30, THE LIST IS READ AGAIN A misread column looks exactly like “not listed.” So the cause-list PDF isn't read in text order. Every character is placed by its position on the page, the columns are found afresh in each document, and each serial number is paired with its case by height. The real lists come in at least three layouts. No column position is hardcoded. “None of your matters are listed” is the one wrong answer this must never give. Read at 19:00, read again at 06:30. The Telangana High Court, most other High Courts and the District Courts. READ IN TEXT ORDER 12 13 14 15

sections.heading: Ask your case file a question. Get the page it came from.
sections.text: 04 · ASK THE FILE Ask your case file a question. Get the page it came from. Case Bot answers from the documents uploaded to your case, with citations back to the passages it used. It searches by meaning and by keyword together, then reranks what it found. Every retrieval step is filtered to your own documents, not just the screen you see. If the owner filter is missing, the search refuses to run at all. When the best match is weak, the answer says so. sections.heading: The earliest possible date, not the most hopeful one.
sections.text: 03 LIMITATION DEADLINES EARLIEST POSSIBLE DATE 14 Oct 2026 s.12(2) Time to obtain a certified copy: noted, not added s.4 Court closed on the last day: noted, not applied s.5 Condonation of delay: noted, not assumed SAMPLE DATA The earliest possible date, not the most hopeful one. Periods come from a rules table written into the code. The computation is conservative: the earliest possible date, with Section 12(2), 4 and 5 caveats stated as notes rather than applied. You add them; nothing fires on its own.

sections.heading: Every matter has an owner. Every query asks who's asking.
sections.text: 06 · WHOSE FILE IS IT Every matter has an owner. Every query asks who's asking. each square, one record · lit: yours · dark: someone else's, never returned SIGN-IN One account, one advocate. Sign up with Google, or from an invitation link with a username and password. Google sends Case Intel your name and verified email address, never your Google password. PER-ADVOCATE ISOLATION Every record has an owner. Cases, documents, hearings, fees: each row carries its owner, and every list, view and edit is filtered to the advocate signed in. A test fails if a new endpoint is added without being scoped
